raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the goal is to resolve each plan's coordinator session from its most recent dispatched run; reckon/crew/plan_coordinator.py:262 resolve_plan_coordinators does so, and the repaired _reviewed_run at plan_coordinator.py:157 now resolves the ordinary run review whose node id embeds the reviewed run's node id.
VERDICT done_when: the done-when names tests/test_a_plans_coordinator_is_derived_from_the_ledger.py beside three sibling gate files; the gate asserts the pinned fixture and its result is recorded in repair-head-plan-coordinator.log (11 passed, EXIT=0) and the coordinator arms coordinator-base-arm.log / coordinator-head-arm.log.
VERDICT write_paths: read the declared paths (reckon/crew/plan_coordinator.py, tests/test_a_plans_coordinator_is_derived_from_the_ledger.py, the landing fragment, a figures directory); every path in the diff against 017b346cb4 is the first three and nothing outside them.
VERDICT manifest: read manifest.md; it names commits 73decd0f4, 20030d0d0, 7defa912d and 8f128748a, the literal gate command, both suite arms, the repair round and four follow-ons, and its after_suite record reconciles with coordinator-head-arm.log.
VERDICT diff: read all four commits against 017b346cb4 — 73decd0f4 adds reckon/crew/plan_coordinator.py and its test, 20030d0d0 and 8f128748a add the landing fragment, 7defa912d repairs the run-review subject resolution — three files, all inside the declared scope.

JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/plan_coordinator.py:262 resolve_plan_coordinators returns each plan's newest in-window coordinator for the plan, plan_link and node matches, and the repaired plan_coordinator.py:157 now resolves a run review through the reviewed run, which the node's 11-case test file pins green.
SCORE evidence: 16
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the done-when gate names tests/test_a_plans_coordinator_is_derived_from_the_ledger.py and its three siblings, and repair-head-plan-coordinator.log:1-2 records the tree, revision and command of the node's own arm (unlike the fused run arm, which was cut off) while coordinator-head-arm.log and coordinator-base-arm.log carry the fused gate receipt.

SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_a_plans_coordinator_is_derived_from_the_ledger.py:335-437 add three run-review guards, and negative-control-plan-coordinator-repair.log shows reverting commit 7defa912d reddens exactly those three, so the repaired branch fails if it regresses.

JUSTIFICATION fit: reckon/crew/plan_coordinator.py:1 follows the surrounding style of reckon/crew/directory.py:1 and adds no plan, sprint or ticket identifier to a symbol, path or comment.
SCORE reuse: 5
JUSTIFICATION reuse: reckon/crew/plan_coordinator.py:157 _reviewed_run and its helper plan_coordinator.py:132 _newest_run_of_node duplicate the review-node-to-reviewed-run resolution already owned by reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:458 _reviewed_run_id and reckon/crew/recovery_review_delivery.py:218 _resolved_reviewed_run_id, extending neither.
FINDING reckon/crew/plan_coordinator.py:157 follow-on: _reviewed_run and _newest_run_of_node re-implement the review-source-to-reviewed-run resolution the repository already owns at reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:458 _reviewed_run_id (source-as-run-id, then newest record whose node id equals source) and reckon/crew/recovery_review_delivery.py:218 _resolved_reviewed_run_id (which adds the durable-row path those functions live over); the addition duplicates both rather than extending either owner, so a further change to how a review names its subject must now be made in three places.
FINDING tests/test_a_plans_coordinator_is_derived_from_the_ledger.py:499 follow-on: test_a_resolver_that_returns_unowned_everywhere_fails_the_fixture and test_a_resolver_blind_to_dispatch_order_fails_the_a_then_b_case (at :529) build their failing input by mutating the resolver's own output dict and then assert an inequality that holds whatever the resolver does, so they compare a value the test itself constructed and would pass against a completely broken resolver; the guards the done-when's negative controls describe are carried by test_the_fixture_pins_each_plans_coordinator (:279) and test_a_later_dispatch_takes_the_plan_over (:306), not here.
